content: gethomepage (homepage) is the de facto homelab dashboard; its Kubernetes integration auto-discovers services from Ingress annotations (gethomepage.dev/enabled, name, group, icon, widget) including pod status via pod-selector — meaning a scaffolded Ingress can automatically appear on the dashboard with zero extra config. ArgoCD's own UI covers deploy state/debugging. Combo of ArgoCD UI (deploy state) + homepage (service directory) is the standard solo-operator visibility stack.
